preconditions.description: The number of additions n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n integers representing parent indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i + 1 for i, p in enumerate(p_list))
preconditions.description: For each addition i (0-indexed), the parent p is a valid existing vertex index between 1 and i+1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each addition step.
Each output line contains a single non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == min_cost_after_step(i + 1, p_list[:i+1]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th output integer equals the minimum possible cost of the tree coloring after the first i+1 additions, where min_cost_after_step computes the maximum over all vertices of the minimum distinct colors on the path from root to that vertex under valid coloring constraints.
